∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → s.card • n ≤ s.sum f
items.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of type $\iota$ and function $f : \iota \to N$ where $N$ is an additive commutative monoid equipped with a partial order and left addition monotonicity, if every element $x \in s$ satisfies $n \leq f(x)$, then the scalar multiplication of the cardinality of $s$ by $n$ is less than or equal to the sum of $f$ over $s$. Formally, $|s| \cdot n \leq \sum_{x \in s} f(x)$.

items.informal_name: Comparison of Infinite Sums via Injective Mapping and Component-wise Inequality
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace α] [OrderClosedTopology α] {f : ι → α} {a₁ a₂ : α} {g : κ → α} (e : ι → κ),
  Function.Injective e → (∀ c ∉ Set.range e, 0 ≤ g c) → (∀ (i : ι), f i ≤ g (e i)) → HasSum f a₁ → HasSum g a₂ → a₁ ≤ a₂
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be an ordered additive commutative monoid equipped with an order-closed topology. For functions $f : \iota \to \alpha$ and $g : \kappa \to \alpha$, suppose there exists an injective map $e : \iota \to \kappa$ such that: (1) $g(c) \geq 0$ for all $c \notin \text{range}(e)$, and (2) $f(i) \leq g(e(i))$ for all $i \in \iota$. If the infinite sum of $f$ converges to $a_1 \in \alpha$ and the infinite sum of $g$ converges to $a_2 \in \alpha$, then $a_1 \leq a_2$.
